assets.name: bolt
assets.prompt: Cute stylized robot kid hero for a mobile endless runner game. Small rounded body, big round glossy helmet head with a dark visor showing two glowing cyan oval eyes, pearl white and sky blue armor plates, pink glowing antenna ball on top, short arms and legs with blue joints, chunky white sneakers. Friendly Pixar-like toy style, clean smooth shapes, full body, standing in A-pose.
